title: Confirmed Chelsea Women line up vs Everton | News | Official Site
text:
Confirmed Chelsea Women line up vs Everton | News | Official Site | Chelsea Football Club 
 Sonia Bompastor has made four changes to her Chelsea side for our Women's Super League match against Everton at Stamford Bridge this afternoon. 
 Following our 6-0 win against Charlton last Sunday, Bompastor had almost a week to prepare for today's home match against Everton. 
 The head coach has switched up her backline, exchanging Nathalie Bjorn and Veerle Buurman for Lucy Bronze and Kadeisha Buchanan . 
 Captain Erin Cuthbert starts in midfield in place of Sjoeke Nusken , while Wieke Kaptein comes in for Lauren James , who sustained a hamstring injury at The Valley last weekend and has been ruled out until the end of the current block of fixtures. 
 Summer signing Manaka Matsukubo retains her place in the side after making her first start for the Blues against Charlton. 
 Chelsea: Hampton, Carpenter, Bronze, Buchanan, McCabe, Cuthbert (c), Walsh, Kaptein, Baltimore, Matsukubo, Malard
 Chelsea substitutes : Peng, Bjorn, Buurman, Potter, Nusken, Dragoni, Hamano, Thompson, Beever-Jones
